```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
```

#Sample Order
```{r}
data("instacart")

set.seed(1)
samples = 
  instacart |>
  distinct(order_id) |>
  slice_sample(n=3000) |>
  pull(order_id)

insta =
  instacart|>
  filter(order_id %in% samples)
```

## Bar Plot
```{r}
insta |>
  count(aisle) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 20) |>
  mutate(aisle = fct_reorder(aisle, n)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~n, 
          y = ~aisle, 
          type = "bar", 
          orientation ="h") |>
  layout( title = "# of items ordered")
```

## Line Plot

```{r}
insta |>
  distinct(order_id, order_hour_of_day) |>
  count(order_hour_of_day) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~order_hour_of_day,
    y = ~n,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers"
         ) |>
  layout(title = "orders by hour of the day")

```

## Box Plot

```{r}
insta |>
  distinct(order_id, order_dow, days_since_prior_order) |>
  mutate(order_dow = factor(order_dow)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~order_dow,
    y = ~days_since_prior_order,
    color = ~order_dow,
    type = "box"
  ) |>
  layout(title = "days since prior order")
```
